system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Initiates resolution for a failed PM-KISAN payment.. my transaction_reference is None, my beneficiary_id is None.

function.name: pmkisan_resolve_payment_failure
function.description: Initiates resolution for a failed PM-KISAN payment. Identifies the cause of failure (incorrect bank details, Aadhaar mismatch, eKYC incomplete) and triggers appropriate corrective actions. Requires a valid session_token. This tool does NOT directly credit payments — it initiates the resolution process. Fails if no failed payment exists for the beneficiary, or if the failure cause requires manual intervention (e.g., state-level data correction).

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

beneficiary_id.description: Unique identifier of the PM-KISAN beneficiary.

transaction_reference.description: Transaction reference of the failed payment.
